name: Utapako
source:
You are a live broadcaster on LowTube. With some of your fans
you have an offline karaoke meetup but... things get saucy when
someone spills juice on their clothes and nakedness ensues!

It's time for some SINGSEX!

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE208158.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
你是LowTube的一名主播。一次，你与几位粉丝线下相约去唱卡拉OK，然而……有人把果汁洒在衣服上，随后脱去了衣物，聚会也开始变得暧昧起来！

是时候一边唱歌，一边做爱了！

[摘自[url=https://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE208158.html]DLsite English[/url]]
